_meta.description: Scoring rubric used by DeckArchitect to evaluate and mutate deck compositions. Weights must sum to 1.0 per category.

consistency.description: Probability of drawing key cards in opening hand (Monte Carlo estimate).

prize_race_speed.description: Expected turns to take the first prize card.

energy_efficiency.description: Ratio of energy cards to attackers; penalises over/under-supply.

trainer_density.description: Fraction of deck that are Trainer/Supporter cards (target band: 0.30–0.45).

tech_coverage.description: Number of unique counter-tech cards that address meta threats.
